name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 5), (1, 3), (1, 4), (1, 5), (2, 3), (2, 5), (3, 4), (3, 5), (4, 5)] as a QUBO with dimod and solve it with SimulatedAnnealingSampler from dwave-samplers. Verify against brute force. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
